scene: The tiny letter unfolds into a three-way transit pass across the city.
picture: A flat side view along the bustling sky deck. On the far left sits a silver light-rail pod with open doors. Left of centre stands the silver-haired boy holding the glowing unfoldable transit pass, his chicken drone hovering nearby. In the centre stretches a moving walkway. Far right stands a glowing glass karaoke elevator.
shown: a sleek silver light-rail pod idling at an open platform gate on the far left
a glowing turquoise moving walkway with yellow handrails running through the centre
a circular glass elevator with neon microphone decals waiting on the far right
